gaps.lead: The plane takes one hour; the train takes two.
gaps.explanation: half the time = twice as fast as.

gaps.lead: She left early because she didn't want to miss the train.
gaps.explanation: so as not to / in order not to + infinitive.

gaps.lead: I'd rather you didn't tell anyone about this.
gaps.explanation: keep something to yourself = tell nobody.

gaps.lead: The staff wear a uniform at all times.
gaps.sentence: The staff ___ a uniform at all times.

gaps.lead: The garage is servicing my car tomorrow morning.
gaps.explanation: Arranged service: have/get something done — having my car serviced.

gaps.lead: 'I've never been to Asia,' she told me.
gaps.sentence: She told me that ___ to Asia.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect shifts to past perfect in reported speech.
